title: Chukkallo Chandrudu
desc: When a rich heir's parents die in a plane crash, he promises his grandfather that he would marry soon. However, he finds himself in a dilemma as he must choose among three vivacious young women.

title: Ekaloveyudu
desc: An unemployed graduate beats someone up in a fit of rage on a fateful night. Unfortunately, his victim turns out to be the son of a moneylender who gave his family money, which causes problems.

title: Adhurs
desc: Twin brothers, separated at birth, grow up in vastly different environments. However, they are reunited when one gets kidnapped by gangsters.

title: Dharma Yogi
desc: Twins Kodi and Anbu have different views when it comes to politics, one is an aggressive campaigner, while the other is a pacifist. However, a twist of fate causes one to adopt the other's life.

title: Anand
desc: After Roopa's family dies in a car accident, she starts living independently with self-esteem. Anand, a rich man, falls in love with her and moves into her neighbourhood to win her over.

title: Super Cowboy
desc: Simhachalam, a watchman, is sentenced to death for stealing a precious diamond. However, a group of cowboys save Simhachalam and offer him the diamond, only on a condition that he fulfils a promise.

title: Bhadram
desc: Vetri, a criminology student, joins a private detective agency and is tasked with gathering information on three people. However, his subjects mysteriously begin to die one by one.

title: Addiction Killer
desc: The host presents a wide range of Ayurvedic remedies for addiction that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.

title: Bhargav
desc: Bhargav is a passionate youth belonging to a simple family. However, his life turns upside down when his brother-in-law turns out to be a smuggler.

title: Sahasam
desc: Gautham, a security guard, comes across his grandfather's diary that takes him on a treasure hunt. Meanwhile, Sultan, a terrorist, holds a Pakistani archaeologist hostage to find a treasure.

title: Vijetha
desc: Madhusudhana Rao, driven by his football ambitions, faces emotional hurdles as he prioritises his father Narasimham's happiness and family unity.

title: Yogi
desc: Eeshwar Prasad, a young man attached to his mother, Shantamma, goes to Hyderabad to earn enough money to make his mother's life comfortable. However, circumstances turn him into a criminal.

title: Goodachari
desc: Gopi is recruited into RAW, but on his graduation day, he is implicated in a plot to kill two RAW officials. Declared a wanted terrorist, Gopi fights to clear his name and find the people responsible.

title: Bhargav
desc: Bhargav is a passionate youth belonging to a simple family. However, his life turns upside down when his brother-in-law turns out to be a smuggler.
